verses.original: וַתְּדַבֵּ֨ר מִרְיָ֤ם וְאַהֲרֹן֙ בְּמֹשֶׁ֔ה עַל־ אֹד֛וֹת הָאִשָּׁ֥ה הַכֻּשִׁ֖ית אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקָ֑ח כִּֽי־ אִשָּׁ֥ה כֻשִׁ֖ית לָקָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḏab·bêr mir·yām wə·’a·hă·rōn bə·mō·šeh ‘al- ’ō·ḏō·wṯ hā·’iš·šāh hak·ku·šîṯ ’ă·šer lā·qāḥ kî- ’iš·šāh ḵu·šîṯ lā·qāḥ
verses.literal: Then Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of . . . the Cushite woman he had married for he had taken a Cushite wife

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ הֲרַ֤ק אַךְ־ בְּמֹשֶׁה֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲלֹ֖א גַּם־ בָּ֣נוּ דִבֵּ֑ר וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū hă·raq ’aḵ- bə·mō·šeh dib·ber Yah·weh hă·lō gam- bā·nū ḏib·bêr way·yiš·ma‘ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Does the LORD speak only . . . through Moses they said Does He not also speak through us And the LORD heard this

verses.original: וְהָאִ֥ישׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה עָנָו מְאֹ֑ד מִכֹּל֙ הָֽאָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’îš mō·šeh ʿå̄·nå̄w mə·’ōḏ mik·kōl hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Now Moses was a very humble man more so than any man on the face of the earth

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה פִּתְאֹ֗ם אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־ מִרְיָ֔ם צְא֥וּ שְׁלָשְׁתְּכֶ֖ם אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיֵּצְא֖וּ שְׁלָשְׁתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh piṯ·’ōm ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- mir·yām ṣə·’ū šə·lā·šə·tə·ḵem ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ way·yê·ṣə·’ū šə·lā·šə·tām
verses.literal: And suddenly the LORD said to Moses Aaron . . . and Miriam You three come out to the Tent of Meeting So the three went out

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהוָה֙ בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֔ן וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וַיִּקְרָא֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּמִרְיָ֔ם וַיֵּצְא֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ Yah·weh bə·‘am·mūḏ ‘ā·nān way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel way·yiq·rā ’a·hă·rōn ū·mir·yām way·yê·ṣə·’ū šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: and the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud stood at the entrance to the Tent and summoned Aaron and Miriam When both of them had stepped forward

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֣א דְבָרָ֑י אִם־ יִֽהְיֶה֙ נְבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם יְהוָ֗ה בַּמַּרְאָה֙ אֵלָ֣יו אֶתְוַדָּ֔ע בַּחֲל֖וֹם אֲדַבֶּר־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šim·‘ū- nā ḏə·ḇā·rāy ’im- yih·yeh nə·ḇî·’ă·ḵem Yah·weh bam·mar·’āh ’ê·lāw ’eṯ·wad·dā‘ ba·ḥă·lō·wm ’ă·ḏab·ber- bōw
verses.literal: He said Hear now My words If there is a prophet among you I, the LORD will reveal Myself to him in a vision I will speak to him in a dream

verses.original: לֹא־ כֵ֖ן עַבְדִּ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּכָל־ בֵּיתִ֖י נֶאֱמָ֥ן הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ḵên ‘aḇ·dî mō·šeh bə·ḵāl bê·ṯî ne·’ĕ·mān hū
verses.literal: But this is not so with My servant Moses he is faithful in all My house

verses.original: פֶּ֣ה אֶל־ פֶּ֞ה אֲדַבֶּר־ בּ֗וֹ וּמַרְאֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א בְחִידֹ֔ת וּתְמֻנַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה יַבִּ֑יט וּמַדּ֙וּעַ֙ לֹ֣א יְרֵאתֶ֔ם לְדַבֵּ֖ר בְּעַבְדִּ֥י בְמֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: peh ’el- peh ’ă·ḏab·ber- bōw ū·mar·’eh wə·lō ḇə·ḥî·ḏōṯ ū·ṯə·mu·naṯ Yah·weh yab·bîṭ ū·mad·dū·a‘ lō yə·rê·ṯem lə·ḏab·bêr bə·‘aḇ·dî ḇə·mō·šeh
verses.literal: I speak with him face to face clearly and not in riddles he sees the form of the LORD Why then were you unafraid to speak against My servant Moses
So the anger of the LORD burned against them and He departed

verses.original: וְהֶעָנָ֗ן סָ֚ר מֵעַ֣ל הָאֹ֔הֶל וְהִנֵּ֥ה מִרְיָ֖ם מְצֹרַ֣עַת כַּשָּׁ֑לֶג וַיִּ֧פֶן אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶל־ מִרְיָ֖ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה מְצֹרָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·nān sār mê·‘al hā·’ō·hel wə·hin·nêh mir·yām mə·ṣō·ra·‘aṯ kaš·šā·leḡ way·yi·p̄en ’a·hă·rōn ’el- mir·yām wə·hin·nêh mə·ṣō·rā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: As the cloud lifted from above the Tent suddenly Miriam became leprous white as snow Aaron turned toward her saw that she was leprous

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י אַל־ נָ֨א תָשֵׁ֤ת עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ חַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר נוֹאַ֖לְנוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’a·hă·rōn ’el- mō·šeh bî ’ă·ḏō·nî ’al- nā ṯā·šêṯ ‘ā·lê·nū ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer nō·w·’al·nū wa·’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā·nū
verses.literal: and said . . . to Moses . . . My lord please do not hold against us this sin we have so foolishly committed

verses.original: אַל־ נָ֥א תְהִ֖י כַּמֵּ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּצֵאתוֹ֙ מֵרֶ֣חֶם אִמּ֔וֹ וַיֵּאָכֵ֖ל חֲצִ֥י בְשָׂרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- nā ṯə·hî kam·mêṯ ’ă·šer bə·ṣê·ṯōw mê·re·ḥem ’im·mōw way·yê·’ā·ḵêl ḥă·ṣî ḇə·śā·rōw
verses.literal: Please do not let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb

verses.original: וַיִּצְעַ֣ק מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵ֕ל נָ֛א רְפָ֥א נָ֖א לָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·‘aq mō·šeh ’el- Yah·weh lê·mōr ’êl nā rə·p̄ā nā lāh
verses.literal: So Moses cried out to the LORD . . . O God please heal her

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְאָבִ֙יהָ֙ יָרֹ֤ק יָרַק֙ בְּפָנֶ֔יהָ הֲלֹ֥א תִכָּלֵ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים תִּסָּגֵ֞ר שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְאַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’ā·ḇî·hā yā·rōq yā·raq bə·p̄ā·ne·hā hă·lō ṯik·kā·lêm šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tis·sā·ḡêr šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh wə·’a·ḥar tê·’ā·sêp̄
verses.literal: But the LORD . . . answered Moses If her father had but spit . . . in her face would she not have been in disgrace for seven days Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days after that she may be brought back in

verses.original: וַתִּסָּגֵ֥ר מִרְיָ֛ם מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְהָעָם֙ לֹ֣א נָסַ֔ע עַד־ הֵאָסֵ֖ף מִרְיָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tis·sā·ḡêr mir·yām mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·hā·‘ām lō nā·sa‘ ‘aḏ- hê·’ā·sêp̄ mir·yām
verses.literal: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days and the people did not move on until she was brought in again

verses.original: וְאַחַ֛ר נָסְע֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מֵחֲצֵר֑וֹת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar nā·sə·‘ū hā·‘ām mê·ḥă·ṣê·rō·wṯ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·miḏ·bar pā·rān
verses.literal: After that the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran
